save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state and RNG states to disk for distributed training
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint from disk restoring model optimizer and RNG states for training resumption
move_weights: move weights from a HuggingFace GPT-2 model to a Megatron model via in-place copy
Timers: create a group of CUDA-synchronized timers to measure and log elapsed time for training operations
print_params_min_max_norm: print the min max and norm values of all model parameters in the optimizer for debugging
